preprocessing_candidate_rule_not_approve.common: No label-informed preprocessing, no row exclusion, no imputation if source values absent, no class balancing, no outlier clipping; preserve source row order. Each feature transformation uses all originally unlabeled-and-labeled source features only as a declared transductive unsupervised step.
preprocessing_candidate_rule_not_approve.population_zscore_original_numeric_featu: for each original numeric column: (x - mean_all_rows)/std_all_rows(ddof=0); refuse zero variance, nonfinite input or output
preprocessing_candidate_rule_not_approve.log1p_nonnegative_then_population_zscore: for Wholesale only: require finite x>=0, x'=log1p(x), then columnwise population z-score as above; no clipping, deletion or fitted supervised step
preprocessing_candidate_rule_not_approve.implementation_versions: Exact floating order, library versions, transformed X bytes and hash must be specified/frozen independently before P2

graph_candidate_rule_not_approved.algorithm_note: Production constructs k+1 nearest neighbors, drops first as presumed self, symmetrizes, temporarily uses CSR only to assemble adjacency, then returns dense padded neib_list(-1) and neib_qt. The PCC propagation consumes the dense representation; no CSR substitution.
before_P2_required: confirm self-exclusion and absence of off-diagonal self-loops for each derived X
check all nodes positive degree and symmetry of active neighbors
hash complete ordered int64 neib_list/neib_qt, source features and transformed features
record exact sklearn/NumPy/SciPy/Python versions and source hash; fail closed on neighbor ordering drift
budget graph and checkpoint memory without a real PCC fit

scientific_design_preserved_from_P1_draf.evaluation_unit: dataset x frozen mask x backend; nodes not independent replicates
scientific_design_preserved_from_P1_draf.per_backend_native_RNG: different native streams, no cross-backend bitwise parity requirement
